ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT GANGONE and CARMELAFICO GANGONE,eachhaving an address at 168Jackson Street, Brooklyn, New York 11211 (collectively, “Transferor") and 174 JACKSON STREET, LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address at 101 Atlantic Avenue,Lynbrook,NewYork 11563("Transferee"). RECITALS: A. Transferor is the owner in fee simple of that certain parcel of land lying and being in the City and State of New York, Kings County, designated as Lot 12 in Block 2750 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County (the “Tax Map") and known by the street address of 172 Jackson Street, Brooklyn, New York, which land is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (the “Transferor's Land"), together with the building and improvements thereon (the “Transferor's Improvements"); the Transferor's Land and Transferor's Improvements herein being referred to collectively as "Transferor's Premises". B. Transferee is the owner in fee simple of that certain parcel of land lying and being in the City and State of New York, Kings County designated as Lot 13 in Block 2750 on the Tax Map and known by the street address of 174 Jackson Street, Brooklyn, New York, which land is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (the “Transferee's Land"), together with the improvements thereon (said existing with any future replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Transferee or Transferee's successors or assigns, and including without limitation, Transferee's New Building (as hereinafter defined); the Transferee's Land, Transferee's Existing Building and Transferee's New Building herein being referred to collectively as “Transferee's Premises". C. Transferee intends to demolish Transferee's Existing Building and construct a new building and improvements on Transferee's Land or renovate and expand Transferee's Existing Building (said new or expanded building and improvements, together with any related improvements, additions, renovations, alterations, restorations, repairs and reconstructions thereto whether made by Transferee or Transferee's Building") with a bulk (as hereinafter defined) in excess of the bulk presently permitted to be constructed on Transferee's Premises under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined). D. The certification by Christopher V. Papa Architect, P.C. (attached hereto as Schedule 1) certifies that the Transferor's Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are 3,756 zoning square feet.
